findings.title: Background reader thread in `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti` is not joined before asserting or finishing the test
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, a background thread is started on line 139–149 that continuously calls `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` until `deletedAll` is set to `true`. On line 155 `deletedAll.set(true)` is called and line 157 immediately asserts `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` without calling `join()` on the thread. Because the thread may still be mid-request when the assertion runs: (1) an exception thrown by an in-flight `groups()` call after line 157 will be missed by the assertion, and (2) the thread can still be executing against `managedRealm` while subsequent tests or test-framework cleanup run. Store the `Thread` reference and `join()` it before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.

findings.title: Other `modelSupplier.get()` callers in `GroupAdapter` still dereference a potentially null `GroupModel`
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` (lines 274–275) was updated to guard against `modelSupplier.get()` returning `null` when a cached group has been concurrently removed from persistence. However, the three `getSubGroupsStream` overloads right above it (lines 256, 262, and 268) still do `return modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` without a null check, so they will still throw a `NullPointerException` under the same concurrent-deletion condition (returning `Stream.empty()` when `model == null` would avoid the NPE).
